subject: Storage Onramp: consultancy handoff and pilot playbook
messages:
From: Alex Turner <alex@pathforge.consulting>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>
Cc: Kai Zhao <kai@vectorwave.io>
Date: Mon, 24 Jun 2028 09:13:00 +0000
Subject: Storage Onramp pilot — quick proposal and team ask

Hi Monica / Ben,

Thanks for taking time last week. As discussed, Pathforge can run a 6-week pilot to validate the S3-backed "onramp" for vector indexes that fall through from Pinecone/Weaviate to pgvector/S3. The pilot goal is to prove:

- deterministic fallthrough behavior (read/write consistency between vector store and S3 blob layer)
- acceptable tail-latency impact under bursty indexing load
- operational playbook for replay/backfill and cold-tier retrieval

Proposed scope (short):
1) Week 0–1: Architecture alignment and security intake (we'll need a short ITHC and an S3 presigned key flow)
2) Week 2–4: Implementation of connector shim + integration tests (pgvector + S3 + indexer)
3) Week 5: Load run & observability validation (traces, token-level cost delta)
4) Week 6: Handoff + runbook + SOW closeout

Estimated effort: 2 FTE Pathforge engineers + 0.5 PM, co-delivered with Redwood eng for platform hooks. Budget estimate in SOW attached.

Questions for you to unblock us:
- Are there any gating compliance items beyond SOC2 we should plan for?
- Preferred sandbox cluster (hosted vs. dedicated)?
- Point of contact for provisioning IAM role / presigned S3 keys?

I'll attach a short SOW draft now; happy to jump on a 30-min sync to finalize the onboarding checklist.

Best,
Alex
Alex Turner
Principal Engineer, Pathforge Consulting
alex@pathforge.consulting

Subject: Re: Storage Onramp pilot — quick proposal and team ask

Alex — thanks for the clear plan and SOW. A few quick notes from our side to make the pilot frictionless: 

- Compliance: SOC2 + standard customer encryption-at-rest requirements should suffice for the sandbox. For Dedicated/Private later we may surface additional requirements (KMS tie-in).
- Sandbox: use our dedicated dev cluster (eu-west-1) for the pilot so we can validate cross-region routing later. Ben, can you provision the cluster and the test org?
- IAM/S3: Marissa — can you take point on generating a constrained presigned-s3 key (writes only, 30-day TTL) for the POC? We'll also need a short audit trail enabled.

Deliverables we want from Pathforge by EOW sprint start: a short runbook (5–7 pages) showing failure modes and an integration test matrix that exercises fallthrough, cold retrieval, and reindexing.

Can we also ask Pathforge to include an optional appendix in the SOW for a production hardening phase (3–4 weeks) so we can budget for it if the pilot succeeds?

If that looks reasonable, I'm happy to greenlight the pilot budget up to the figure in the attachment. Let's schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow.

Thanks,
Monica
Monica Patel
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.inference

Thanks for the updates, Monica. Attached are: (1) revised SOW with optional production hardening appendix, (2) a compact architecture diagram, and (3) a proposed test matrix. Key technical clarifications inline below.

Technical clarifications:
- Fallthrough semantics: we recommend a write-through replication model for index inserts where the vector index write is considered successful only after S3 blob write completes (helps avoid drift); Pathforge will instrument a compensating reindex job for any partial failures. This keeps read consistency but adds ~25–40ms p95 on write path in our microbenchmarks.
- Cold retrieval: S3 objects will be compressed and chunked; we’ll add a small metadata index in pgvector rows pointing to S3 segments to accelerate retrieval without full blob downloads.
- Observability: we will emit trace spans with request ids and token-level cost deltas back to the Redwood observability endpoint; we need a holder API key for that.

Security notes:
- We will sign an NDA and accept an onboarding security questionnaire. We can operate with a constrained presigned S3 key for the pilot; for Dedicated/Private we recommend KMS key wrapping.

Attached: SOW-Pathforge-Redwood-StorageOnramp-v1.pdf (application/pdf); storage-onramp-arch-diagram.png (image/png)

Let me know if you want adjustments to the fallthrough semantics — we can prototype both write-through and async-write-with-compaction as part of the pilot, but that will increase cost.

Best,
Alex
